notes: The operator's Kart #1 course uses both west and east kart loops: Long Beach, The Glen, Zolder, Daytona, Imola, Monza, the Mulsanne Straight and Monte Carlo triangular return via Spa. The independently visible paved centerline retains those branches and excludes the oval shortcut, hot pits and surrounding main road circuit. Operator route dimensions identify a full course of roughly 952 m; mapping is not scaled to that distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1025.0 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 27 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
